status: WITHDRAWAL AND REPLACEMENT of the §5 compression ratio. The 2x2 contingency counts of the 20260714 dataset are UNAFFECTED and independently reproduced (see verification below).

what_was_wrong.defect: instrument mismatch across the two sides of the ratio
what_was_wrong.detail: The alive side measured institutional affiliation through the Zenodo Search API against full record metadata including creators[].affiliation. The deletion side measured a substring match on citation_text, which is 'Author. (Year). Title. Publisher. DOI' and contains no affiliation field. The deletion side could not measure the construct the alive side measured; the ratio between them is dominated by the gap between instruments.

defect_measured.note: The two instruments agree on 1 record in 400. They are not noisy versions of one measurement.

what_was_wrong.matched_instrument_check: Applying the deletion-side instrument to BOTH sides gives alive 1.3% vs deleted 1.0% — the published effect disappears entirely under the published instrument.

how_it_was_repaired.method: reconstruct affiliation for deleted records from a registry that ingested them before deletion, then hold both sides to the same AI classifier and the same affiliation instrument

datacite.finding: Zenodo deletion cascades into destruction of the DataCite descriptive record for essentially every deleted record, not only the CHA cohort. Recorded as a finding in its own right.

how_it_was_repaired.ai_classifier: the audit's own 23-term panel, applied to a citation string constructed identically on both sides

corrected_result.interpretation: The direction and statistical significance of the v0.1 finding survive instrument correction. The magnitude does not. 31.2x is withdrawn; 7.6x replaces it.

secondary_defects_found.institutional_classifier_field_scope: In the not_ai_and_institutional cell (n=1136), the institutional term sits in the TITLE rather than an author or publisher field in 787 rows (69.3%). Romance-language topic adjectives ('universitaria', 'universitarios') score as institutional. Author field 12.1%, publisher field 18.6%.
secondary_defects_found.cell_non_independence: 474 of those 1136 rows (41.7%) are one author (de la Serna Tuya, J. M., two spellings) depositing multilingual variants of the same study, one record per language. The cell's rows are not independent observations.
secondary_defects_found.population_concentration: One depositor accounts for 60,527 of the 100,313-row population (60.3%); the top ten account for 65.6%. Any population-level claim from this export must disclose this. NOTE: that depositor is only ~6% of the AI-signalled deletion sample, so the corrected §5 comparison is NOT driven by the cascade.
secondary_defects_found.self_inclusion: The Crimson Hexagonal Archive's own deleted records sit inside the audit population: 63 rows in the not_ai_and_institutional cell, 25 of them under 'Sharks, L.' Small, but declared.

what_is_unaffected.contingency_counts: Independently recomputed 2026-08-27 from the md5-verified container (deleted-head-20260710.csv.gz, md5 33877aba1fb5684f86758cb86ddc1ad4, 1,322,007 rows). All four cells and the population reproduce exactly: population 100313, ai_inst 60, ai_no_inst 5965, no_ai_inst 1136, no_ai_no_inst 93152.
what_is_unaffected.coincidence_resolved: The value 1136 appears in three places. Two are the same population counted twice (the CHA kill-ledger row count and the tombstone census 'records' figure). The third, the not_ai_and_institutional cell, is an independent quantity that lands on the same number by coincidence; it is not a plumbing error, and generate_audit.py contains no CHA reference.
what_is_unaffected.other_findings: The programmed-suppression finding (exporter source stripping citation_text under the spam label; EXPORTER_NUMBER_VERSIONS_TO_KEEP = 3), the Wu restoration cascade, and the tombstone census do not route through this comparison and are unaffected. The corpus-level LLM contamination finding uses a separate methodology and was not examined here.

carried_limitations: OpenAlex coverage differs by side (77% alive / 66% deleted); the reconstructable subset is the population and non-coverage may not be random
the alive sampling frame is search-enriched, not random; only the classifier is matched, not the frame
affiliation-data density ran 49% alive against 77% deleted in the AI subset — backwards from expectation, unexplained
single seeded realization; intervals are Wilson score on the reconstructable subset
erratum_status: The canonical deposit text (AXN:044A, #1081) is NOT rewritten. Following the ruling on deposit #199 (2026-08-27), correction is registry-level: this dataset supersedes the derived_ratios of the 20260714 contingency dataset, and a separate erratum deposit cross-referenced to #1081 is OWED and not yet minted.
